_note: Evidence items per phase or gate. Phases 0 to 4 apply once ADR-0026 is accepted. Gate entries G0 to G5 are transcribed from docs/GATES.md, which wins if they differ; a gate also needs every plan row in that gate to be done. plan_rows are filled in as phase rows exist. Edited only by founder decision, never to make a failing run pass (docs/RULES.md rule 48).

Lead conversations held and a recorded decision on whether a pilot is credible

Arabic document output and role views reviewed
Versioned Blueprint-to-engine mapping proved with the real adapter for customer, item price, sales order and invoice

One guarded change with a diff and a tested recovery
